note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sends a 1 OC Mek 14.6 in forward to an objective that is already held. The expected_vp term of 7.0 counts the whole objective's value, not this unit's marginal value. That term gets credit for VP that the Stormboyz already secure. Fix: Compute expected_vp as the marginal change in control probability caused by this unit. If the objective is already held with OC above the enemy's reachable OC, set expected_vp near zero. Give support units a bonus for staying near home, or for moving toward the unit that needs backup, instead.
